questions.question: Explain the two conditions that the numbers used to split the middle term must meet in the factoring by grouping method.
questions.expected_answer: The two numbers must multiply together to give the product of the 'a' and 'c' coefficients, and they must add together to give the 'b' coefficient.

questions.question: Describe what the Zero-Product Property is and why it is useful when solving quadratic equations.
questions.expected_answer: The Zero-Product Property states that if two factors multiply to zero, at least one of them must be zero. It's useful because it allows us to take a factored quadratic equation and split it into two simple linear equations to solve for x.
